fields.name: status
fields.label: Publishing Status
fields.description: Only published campaigns are copied to the public campaign store.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: URL Slug
fields.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: Public Start
fields.description: Include the intended time and UTC offset; the public API evaluates this instant in UTC.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Public End
fields.description: The campaign stops being active at this exact instant.

fields.name: promotionPriority
fields.label: Promotion Priority
fields.description: 0–100. The highest-priority active campaign wins a placement.

fields.name: redirectUrl
fields.label: Redirect URL
fields.description: Required only when Behavior is redirect.
